images.alt: Cat Wylde, Andy McKay, Darby Bracken and Janey Hilford of Kapiti Coast District Council, with David Barnes, regional field advisor for Herenga ā Nuku, all standing on a newly marked route that gives access to the Waitohu catchment in Tararua Forest Park.

post.text: We have just posted Cat Wylde, Andy McKay, Darby Bracken and Janey Hilford, of Kapiti Coast District Council, chocolate fish to thank them for the work they did marking a route that gives access to the Waitohu catchment in Tararua Forest Park. 🐟🐟🐟🐟
